examples.cn: 面对暴风雨，我们感到无能为力。

examples.en: She was helpless with laughter.
examples.cn: 她笑得不能自已。

dict_mnemonic.text: helpless 是「无助的」，由 help 加否定后缀 -less 构成；feel helpless 是感到无助，helpless against 是对……无能为力，helpless with laughter 是笑得不能自已。

root: 由 help（帮助）加否定后缀 -less（没有……的）构成，字面是没有帮助可依靠的，因此表示无助的、无能为力的。

sensesIntro.en: Helpless means unable to care for yourself or to change a situation.
sensesIntro.cn: helpless 表示无法照顾自己，或无法改变处境。

core.en: A hand reaching out and closing on nothing.
core.cn: 一只手伸出去，却什么也抓不到。

branches.en: The baby is too young and completely helpless.
branches.cn: 婴儿还太小，完全无助。

branches.en: We felt helpless against the storm.
branches.cn: 面对暴风雨，我们感到无能为力。

branches.en: Being without help and being without power feel the same.
branches.cn: 没有帮助和没有力量，感觉是一样的。

branches.en: He felt helpless watching the fire.
branches.cn: 看着大火，他感到无能为力。

branches.en: The injured bird lay helpless on the grass.
branches.cn: 受伤的鸟无助地躺在草地上。

intro.en: Helpless takes -ly and -ness, and is built from help plus -less.
intro.cn: helpless 可加 -ly 和 -ness，由 help 加 -less 构成。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the base word is Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，其基础词属于日耳曼语来源。

items.example: Please help me with this box.
She felt hopeful about the result.

items.exampleCN: 这任务看起来毫无希望。

items.example: The hapless traveller missed the train.
items.exampleCN: 倒霉的旅客错过了火车。

definition_zh: 意图；目的；adj. 专注的；坚决的
definition_en: a purpose or aim, or being firmly fixed on doing something
core_image: 一双眼睛盯住门口的动静，肩膀一动不动
scene: 猫伏在门口，耳朵贴着门缝，一动不动地等那阵脚步声。 Her intent was never to embarrass him, only to warn him.
sceneCN: 这里 intent 是「意图」（第 1 个义项：心里想达到的目的），句意她的意图从不是让他难堪，只是提醒他。画面里的物件：门缝、猫的耳朵、静止的肩膀。

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -ion 构成，义为「意图；打算」
由本词加 -ly 构成，义为「专注地」
由 intention 加 -al 构成，义为「故意的」
由同一词干构成，义为「打算」

senses.title: Purpose behind an act
senses.definition: the purpose or aim that lies behind what someone does
senses.definitionCN: 某人行为背后的目的或目标
senses.example: The court asked whether there was intent to defraud.
senses.exampleCN: 法庭追问是否有欺诈的意图。
senses.why: Latin intentus, the participle of intendere, hardened into a noun for a fixed aim.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语分词 intentus 硬化为表示「既定目标」的名词。

senses.title: Fixed attention
senses.definition: giving all your attention to something, often with the body still
senses.definitionCN: 把全部注意力放在某物上，身体往往一动不动
senses.example: The children were intent on the magician's hands.
senses.exampleCN: 孩子们紧盯着魔术师的手。
senses.why: The adjective keeps the physical image of a stretched, unmoving posture.
senses.whyCN: 这个形容词保留了「绷紧、不动」的身体形象。

senses.title: Firmly determined
senses.definition: strongly determined to do something and unlikely to be turned aside
senses.definitionCN: 坚决要做某事，不易被劝开
senses.example: He was intent on finishing the climb before dark.
senses.exampleCN: 他一心要在天黑前登顶。
senses.why: Determination is an aim that will not let the mind relax.
senses.whyCN: 决心是那个不让心思松下来的目标。

intro.en: Intent is the Latin participle of intendere used as a noun and an adjective in English.
intro.cn: intent 是拉丁语 intendere 的分词，在英语中兼作名词与形容词。

items.en: Tendere "to stretch" with in- "towards" gives intendere, to aim the mind.
items.cn: tendere「伸展」与 in-「朝向」构成 intendere「把心瞄向某处」。

items.en: The participle intensus described a mind or a bow held taut.
items.cn: 分词 intensus 形容绷紧的心或弓。

items.en: Legal Latin used intentio for the aim that gives an act its character.
items.cn: 法律拉丁语用 intentio 指赋予行为性质的那个目的。

items.en: French entent brought both the noun and the adjective into English.
items.cn: 法语 entent 把名词与形容词一起带入英语。

items.en: Modern law keeps intent as a technical word; everyday speech uses it for absorbed attention.
items.cn: 现代法律保留 intent 为术语，日常言语则用它表示全神贯注。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the aiming root; the near-meaning group holds other words for purpose.
note.cn: 形近组共享「瞄准」词根；近义组收其他表示目的的词语。

entries.definition: The verb of planning to do something.
A plan, often less fixed or formal than intent.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「意图」，比 intent 更常指初步想法。

entries.definition: Satisfied, or what something holds.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词义为「满足的」，名词义为「内容」。

entries.definition: The reason for which something is done.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「目的」，做事的理由。

entries.definition: The target one tries to reach.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「目标」，想达到的那一点。

entries.definition: Firmness of will, the quality rather than the goal.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「决心」，指品质而非目标。

normalIntro.en: The hooks take the taut bow of intendere and the legal phrase with intent.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子取自 intendere 那张绷紧的弓，以及法律短语 with intent。

normal.en: Intent is an aim pulled tight and held.
normal.cn: intent 是一个被拉紧且保持住的目标。

normal.en: The police asked about intent, not about accident.
normal.cn: 警方问的是意图，而不是意外。

normal.en: Be intent on the road, not on the phone.
normal.cn: 要专注于路，而不是手机。

normal.en: For all intents and purposes, the deal is done.
normal.cn: 就各方面而言，这笔交易已成。

normal.en: An intent look is quiet, not busy.
normal.cn: 专注的神情是静的，不是忙的。

abstract.en: Intent is the arrow's straight line before release.
abstract.cn: 意图是离弦前那支箭的直线。

abstract.en: We cannot see intent, only its shadow in behaviour.
abstract.cn: 我们看不见意图，只能看见它在行为里的影子。

abstract.en: A fixed eye makes a still body.
abstract.cn: 目光一固定，身体就静止。

examples.en: His intent was to protect the family business.
examples.cn: 他的意图是保住家族生意。

examples.en: The boy sat intent on his drawing for an hour.
examples.cn: 男孩专心画画，坐了一小时。

examples.en: She was intent on reaching the summit by noon.
examples.cn: 她一心想在中午前登顶。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「因贴他」——心里贴着某个目标，就是意图

root: 拉丁语 tendere「伸展」→ intendere「把心瞄向」→ 分词 intensus → 古法语 entent → 英语 intent。同族：intend、intention、intentive。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses: a purpose, fixed attention, and firm determination.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项：目的、专注，以及坚定的决心。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a body held still with eyes locked on one point.
core.cn: 核心意象：身体一动不动，双眼锁住一点。

branches.en: THE COURTROOM: the purpose behind an act is examined.
branches.cn: 法庭这条线：审的是行为背后的目的。

branches.en: THE MAGICIAN'S HANDS: attention is all given.
branches.cn: 魔术师的手这条线：注意力全部交出。

branches.en: THE CLIMB: the aim will not let the will relax.
branches.cn: 登山这条线：目标不让意志松手。

branches.en: THE LINK: purpose and will both keep one point fixed.
branches.cn: 连接线：目的与意志都把一点固定住。

branches.en: THE LINK: absorbed attention looks like determination.
branches.cn: 连接线：全神贯注看起来就像决心。

intro.en: Intent = in- "towards" + tent-, the participle stem of tendere "to stretch".
intro.cn: intent = in-「朝向」+ tent-，即 tendere「伸展」的分词词干。

latinIntro.en: Latin intendere and its participle intensus are recorded forms.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 intendere 及其分词 intensus 均有记载。

items.example: It gives the aim a direction.
The same stem is in attention.
The base verb of the family.

items.exampleCN: 法律拉丁语使其成为术语。

definition_zh: 滚筒；滚轴；卷发筒；巨浪
definition_en: a tube or wheel that turns, used to spread paint, curl hair, or smooth a surface
core_image: 一把沾满油漆的滚筒
scene: 工人用滚筒把新漆刷到墙上。 The worker used a roller to spread fresh paint on the wall.
sceneCN: 这里 roller 是「滚筒」（第 1 个义项）；句意：工人用滚筒把新漆刷到墙上。

senses.title: Turning tool
senses.definition: a cylinder that turns and is used to spread, press, or smooth something
senses.definitionCN: 可转动、用于涂抹、压平或碾平的圆柱形工具
senses.example: He cleaned the paint roller after work.
senses.exampleCN: 收工后他清洗了油漆滚筒。
senses.why: A turning tube carries material across a surface.
senses.whyCN: 转动的圆筒把材料带到表面上。

senses.title: Hair curler
senses.definition: a small tube around which hair is rolled to make it curl
senses.definitionCN: 把头发卷起来使其弯曲的小圆筒
senses.example: She put a roller in her fringe.
senses.exampleCN: 她用卷发筒卷住了刘海。
senses.why: The hair is wrapped around the little tube.
senses.whyCN: 头发被缠绕在小圆筒上。

senses.title: Big wave
senses.definition: a long large wave that rolls toward the shore
senses.definitionCN: 朝岸边滚来的长而大的浪
senses.example: A heavy roller broke against the pier.
senses.exampleCN: 一道巨浪拍在码头上。
senses.why: The water itself moves in a rolling curve.
senses.whyCN: 海水本身以滚动的曲线推进。

intro.en: Roller is roll plus the suffix -er, the thing that rolls.
intro.cn: roller 由 roll 加后缀 -er 构成，指会滚动的东西。

items.en: Roll names the turning movement.
items.cn: roll 指滚动的动作。

items.en: The suffix -er marks the tool that does it.
items.cn: 后缀 -er 标记执行该动作的工具。

items.en: Roller first names a small wheel.
items.cn: roller 最初指小轮子。

items.en: Roller extends to paint rollers and hair curlers.
items.cn: roller 扩展到油漆滚筒与卷发筒。

items.en: Roller coaster adds the image of a racing track.
items.cn: roller coaster 增加了轨道飞驰的意象。

note.en: A roller turns; a roll is what it shapes.
note.cn: roller 是会转动的工具，roll 则是被卷成的东西。

entries.definition: to turn over and over
turning slowly
a part played
a shape with round ends
a round object that turns
a round hollow object

normalIntro.en: A roller is the round tool that turns over a surface.
normalIntro.cn: roller 是在表面上转动的圆筒工具。

normal.en: Use a roller to paint the long wall.
normal.cn: 用滚筒来刷这面长墙。

normal.en: The roller coaster made everyone scream.
normal.cn: 过山车让所有人都尖叫。

normal.en: He put on his roller skates.
normal.cn: 他穿上了旱冰鞋。

normal.en: The roller blind keeps the room dark.
normal.cn: 卷帘让房间保持黑暗。

normal.en: A road roller smoothed the new asphalt.
normal.cn: 压路机压平了新沥青。

abstract.en: Picture a paint-soaked tube leaving a wide stripe.
abstract.cn: 想象一个吸满油漆的圆筒留下一道宽痕。

abstract.en: Imagine hair curled around a small tube.
abstract.cn: 想象头发绕着小圆筒卷起。

abstract.en: Think of a long wave curling toward the beach.
abstract.cn: 想象一道长浪卷向海滩。

examples.en: She bought a new roller for the ceiling.
examples.cn: 她买了一个刷天花板的新滚筒。

examples.en: The roller coaster stopped at the top.
examples.cn: 过山车在最高点停了一下。

examples.en: A roller broke over the rocks.
examples.cn: 一道巨浪在礁石上碎裂。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「roll（滚）＋ er（的东西）」——会滚的圆筒就是滚筒；头发绕着它转，就成了卷发筒。

root: roll（滚动）＋ -er（工具）→ roller，核心义「会转动的圆筒形工具」。

sensesIntro.en: Roller means a turning tube for paint or smoothing, a hair curler, or a long rolling wave.
sensesIntro.cn: roller 意为涂刷或压平的滚筒、卷发筒，或滚动的巨浪。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a paint-soaked roller on a wall.
core.cn: 核心意象：刷在墙上的油漆滚筒。

branches.en: The turning tool is the main sense.
branches.cn: 可转动的工具是主要义项。

branches.en: A small tube curls the hair.
branches.cn: 小圆筒把头发卷曲。

branches.en: A wave rolls like a giant tube.
branches.cn: 海浪像巨大的圆筒一样滚动。

branches.en: Both are tubes turned around something.
branches.cn: 两者都是绕着某物转的圆筒。

branches.en: Both keep the image of rolling motion.
branches.cn: 两者都保留滚动的意象。

intro.en: Roller is an English compound of roll and -er.
intro.cn: roller 是 roll 与 -er 组成的英语派生词。

latinIntro.en: Its deeper root is Latin rotula, a small wheel.
latinIntro.cn: 它更深的词根是拉丁语 rotula，意为小轮。

items.example: Roller coaster is a fairground ride.
items.exampleCN: roller coaster 是游乐场设施。

latinEntries.exampleCN: rotula 是 roller 的深层来源。

definition_zh: 纤维；纤维材料；膳食纤维；品格
definition_en: a thin thread-like part of a material, the part of food that helps digestion, or strength of character
core_image: 麻绳被捻开，细丝在光里散成一片
scene: 她把麻绳捻开，露出一缕缕细丝。 The rope is made of natural fibre.
sceneCN: 这里 fibre 是「纤维」（第 1 个义项）；句意：这根绳子由天然纤维制成。

senses.title: Thin thread
senses.definition: a thin thread-like part of a natural or artificial material
senses.definitionCN: 天然或人造材料中细线状的部分
senses.example: The rope is made of natural fibre.
senses.exampleCN: 这根绳子由天然纤维制成。
senses.why: This is the basic material sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是基本的材料义。

senses.title: Dietary fibre
senses.definition: the part of plant food that helps digestion
senses.definitionCN: 植物性食物中帮助消化的部分
senses.example: Beans are high in fibre.
senses.exampleCN: 豆类富含膳食纤维。
senses.why: Food science uses fibre for indigestible plant matter.
senses.whyCN: 食品科学用 fibre 指不可消化的植物成分。

senses.title: Strength of character
senses.definition: the quality of strong moral character
senses.definitionCN: 坚强的道德品格
senses.example: The crisis tested the moral fibre of the town.
senses.exampleCN: 这场危机考验了全镇的道德品格。
senses.why: The image of tough threads became a moral metaphor.
senses.whyCN: 坚韧纤维的意象被用作道德比喻。

intro.en: Fibre comes from Latin fibra, a thread or filament, through French fibre.
intro.cn: fibre 源自拉丁语 fibra（细线、纤维），经法语 fibre 进入英语。

items.en: Fibra meant a thread or fine filament.
items.cn: fibra 意为细线、纤维。

items.en: Fibre kept the same material sense.
items.cn: 法语 fibre 保留了相同的材料义。

items.en: English fibre described threads in plants and cloth.
items.cn: 英语 fibre 指植物与织物中的细丝。

items.en: Industry added glass and carbon fibres.
items.cn: 工业领域增加了玻璃纤维与碳纤维。

items.en: Medicine and ethics gave it new uses.
items.cn: 医学与伦理学又赋予它新的用法。

note.en: Fibre is compared with similar-looking words and with words for threads.
note.cn: 把 fibre 与形近词以及表示细线的词作比较。

entries.definition: the American spelling of fibre
made of fibres
glass made into fibres
a thin line of spun fibre
a very thin thread
one thin piece of fibre

normalIntro.en: Fibre means a thin thread, the rough part of food, or moral strength.
normalIntro.cn: fibre 意为细纤维、食物中的纤维，或道德品格。

normal.en: Natural fibres come from plants or animals.
normal.cn: 天然纤维来自植物或动物。

normal.en: Vegetables are high in fibre.
normal.cn: 蔬菜富含纤维。

normal.en: Carbon fibre is strong and light.
normal.cn: 碳纤维又强又轻。

normal.en: Fibre optics carry light through glass threads.
normal.cn: 光纤让光在玻璃丝中传输。

normal.en: Moral fibre means strength of character.
normal.cn: moral fibre 意为品格的力量。

abstract.en: Many thin threads together make a strong rope.
abstract.cn: 许多细丝合在一起就成了结实的绳。

abstract.en: What cannot be digested can still keep the body well.
abstract.cn: 无法消化的东西，也能让身体保持良好。

abstract.en: Character, like cloth, is woven thread by thread.
abstract.cn: 品格如布，是一缕一缕织成的。

examples.en: The rope is made of natural fibre.
examples.cn: 这根绳子由天然纤维制成。

examples.en: Beans are high in fibre.
examples.cn: 豆类富含膳食纤维。

examples.en: The crisis tested the moral fibre of the town.
examples.cn: 这场危机考验了全镇的道德品格。

dict_mnemonic.text: fibre 源自拉丁语 fibra（细丝），由材料纤维引申到膳食纤维，再比喻为道德品格。

root: 源自拉丁语 fibra（细线、纤维），核心义「细长的一缕」。

sensesIntro.en: Fibre means a thin thread, dietary fibre, or strength of character.
sensesIntro.cn: fibre 意为纤维、膳食纤维或品格。

core.en: A fine strand of material.
core.cn: 材料中细细的一缕。

branches.en: A single thin strand.
branches.cn: 单独的一缕细丝。

branches.en: Many strands woven into cloth.
branches.cn: 许多细丝织成布料。

branches.en: The plant matter that aids digestion.
branches.cn: 帮助消化的植物成分。

branches.en: Inner strength pictured as tough thread.
branches.cn: 被比作坚韧丝线的内在力量。

branches.en: Material and moral strength share one image.
branches.cn: 物质与道德的坚韧共享同一意象。

intro.en: Fibre forms compounds for glass, optics, and character.
intro.cn: fibre 可构成玻璃纤维、光纤、品格等复合词。

latinIntro.en: Latin fibra is the historical base.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 fibra 是历史词根。

items.example: The stem has a fibrous texture.
The boat is made of fibreglass.

items.meaning: using glass threads to carry light

items.exampleCN: 他们修补了玻璃钢船体。

items.example: The scan showed a small fibroid.
items.exampleCN: 扫描显示一个小纤维瘤。

definition_zh: 中间的；中级的；n. 中间物；中级学习者
definition_en: coming between two things in level or position, or a person at a middle stage of learning
core_image: 三段楼梯中间的第三级台阶上放着一盏灯，上下各有台阶
scene: 语言班门口挂着一块牌子，把班级分成初级、中级、高级三栏。 She moved from the beginner class to an intermediate one in a term.
sceneCN: 这里 intermediate 是「中级的」（第 1 个义项：处于两端之间），句意她一个学期就从初级班升到了中级班。画面里的物件：班级分栏牌、台阶、课本。

pos.zh: 形容词：中间的；中级的；中等的
名词：中间物；中级学习者

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -ion 构成，义为「居间调解；中介」
由同一词干构成，义为「中间人」
去掉前缀 inter- 的直接对照词，义为「立即的；直接的」
由同一拉丁词干构成，义为「调解者」

senses.title: In the middle of a scale
senses.definition: at a level between the basic and the advanced
senses.definitionCN: 处于基础与高级之间的水平
senses.example: The book is written for intermediate learners of English.
senses.exampleCN: 这本书是为中级英语学习者写的。
senses.why: The Latin stem medius "middle" with inter- marks a point between two ends.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语词干 medius「中间」与 inter- 相合，标出介于两端之间的点。

senses.title: Between two stages or places
senses.definition: happening or lying between two other things in time or space
senses.definitionCN: 在时间或位置上位于另外两事之间
senses.example: The larva spends several weeks in an intermediate stage.
senses.exampleCN: 幼虫在中间阶段要经过好几周。
senses.why: Latin medius "middle" with inter- marks a point that is in between.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 medius「中间」与 inter- 相合，标出介于两者之间的点。

senses.title: Not directly connected
senses.definition: happening through an extra step rather than directly
senses.definitionCN: 经由额外一步而非直接地发生
senses.example: The sugar is broken down into intermediate products first.
senses.exampleCN: 糖先被分解成中间产物。
senses.why: Chemistry and economics both need names for halfway results.
senses.whyCN: 化学与经济学都需要为半途的产物命名。

senses.title: A person at that level
senses.definition: a learner or athlete who is no longer a beginner but not yet advanced
senses.definitionCN: 已不是新手但尚未达到高水平的学练者
senses.example: The class mixes intermediates with a few beginners.
senses.exampleCN: 这个班以中级学员为主，也混着几个新手。
senses.why: The adjective turned into a noun for people in the middle band.
senses.whyCN: 这个形容词活用作名词，指处在中间一档的人。

intro.en: Intermediate joins Latin inter- "between" to medius "middle", with the adjective ending -ate.
intro.cn: intermediate 把拉丁语 inter-「在……之间」接到 medius「中间」上，再加形容词词尾 -ate。

items.en: Medius means middle, and gives English medium and mediate.
items.cn: medius 意为「中间的」，给出英语 medium 与 mediate。

items.en: Mediatus, the participle of mediare "to be in the middle", supplied the ending.
items.cn: mediare「居于中间」的分词 mediatus 提供了词尾。

items.en: Intermediatus named what lies between two stages.
items.cn: intermediatus 指位于两个阶段之间之物。

items.en: English adopted intermediate for space, then for levels of skill.
items.cn: 英语先用 intermediate 指空间，再指技能等级。

items.en: Schools and exams fixed it as the band between beginner and advanced.
items.cn: 学校与考试把它固定为初级与高级之间的那一档。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the middle root medius; the near-meaning group holds other words for middleness.
note.cn: 形近组共享「中间」词根 medius；近义组收其他表示居中的词。

entries.definition: With nothing in between, hence instant.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「立即的、直接的」。

entries.definition: A person or body that goes between others.
A middle size, or a means of communication.
The everyday word for the central part.
entries.definitionCN: 名词或形容词，最日常的「中间」。

entries.definition: Neither great nor small; not extreme.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「适中的」，不极端。

entries.definition: Belonging to a period of change between two states.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「过渡的」，处于变化之中。

normalIntro.en: The hooks split the word into inter- and media, the Latin middle.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子把词分成 inter- 与拉丁语表示「中间」的 media。

normal.en: Inter plus media: between the middles, that is, in the middle.
normal.cn: inter 加 media：在中间之中，也就是居中。

normal.en: Beginner, intermediate, advanced: three steps on one stair.
normal.cn: 初级、中级、高级：一道楼梯上的三级。

normal.en: An intermediate stage stands between egg and adult.
normal.cn: 中间阶段站在卵与成虫之间。

normal.en: Immediate has no middle; intermediate is all middle.
normal.cn: immediate 没有中间，intermediate 全是中间。

normal.en: Upper intermediate is still not advanced.
normal.cn: 中高级仍不算高级。

abstract.en: The middle step carries the weight of both directions.
abstract.cn: 中间那级台阶承担着两个方向的重量。

abstract.en: Some things are only ever intermediate, never final.
abstract.cn: 有些东西永远是中途，从不到终点。

abstract.en: Being intermediate is a place to stand, not a verdict.
abstract.cn: 处在中游是一个立足处，不是判决。

examples.en: She joined an intermediate swimming class at fourteen.
examples.cn: 她十四岁时参加了中级游泳班。

examples.en: The two towns are linked by an intermediate station.
examples.cn: 两镇之间靠一个中间站相连。

examples.en: In this reaction an intermediate compound forms and quickly breaks up.
examples.cn: 在这个反应中会先生成一种中间化合物，随后很快分解。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「因特米迪特」——网上找米迪特的秘诀，先从中级练起

root: 拉丁语 medius「中间的」→ inter-「在……之间」+ mediare「居于中间」→ intermediatus → 英语 intermediate。同族：medium、mediate、immediate、intermediary。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses: a middle level, a stage between two, products formed midway, and the people at that level.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项：中间水平、介于两阶段之间、中途产物，以及处在该档的人。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a lamp on the middle step between top and bottom.
core.cn: 核心意象：上下台阶之间的那级台阶上放着灯。

branches.en: THE CLASS LIST: three columns with the middle filled first.
branches.cn: 班级分栏这条线：三栏中最先填满中间一栏。

branches.en: THE LARVA: a body holds a place between two forms.
branches.cn: 幼虫这条线：身体占据两种形态之间的位置。

branches.en: THE REACTION: halfway products appear and vanish.
branches.cn: 反应这条线：中途产物出现又消失。

branches.en: THE SWIMMER: a person occupies the middle band.
branches.cn: 游泳者这条线：人占据中档。

branches.en: THE LINK: bands of skill are stages on a path.
branches.cn: 连接线：技能档次就是路上的阶段。

intro.en: Intermediate = inter- "between" + medi- "middle" + -ate, an adjective ending.
intro.cn: intermediate = inter-「在……之间」+ medi-「中间」+ -ate（形容词词尾）。

latinIntro.en: Latin medius and mediare are recorded; intermediatus is medieval Latin.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 medius 与 mediare 有记载，intermediatus 是中世纪拉丁语。

items.example: It places the middle between two ends.
items.exampleCN: 它把「中」安放在两端之间。
也见于 medium 与 median。

items.example: It makes the word an adjective.
items.exampleCN: 它使这个词成为形容词。

items.example: It denies the middle in immediate.
items.exampleCN: 它在 immediate 中否定「中间」。

latinEntries.meaning: to be in the middle, to mediate

definition_zh: 暴露；曝光；揭露；接触
definition_en: the state of being unprotected; public attention in the media; the act of revealing a secret; experience of something
core_image: 一块遮布被掀开后，物体完全显露在众人眼前
scene: 长期暴露在噪音中会损害听力。 Long exposure to noise can damage hearing.
sceneCN: 这里 exposure 是「暴露、接触」（第 1 个义项）；句意：长期暴露在噪音中会损害听力。

senses.title: Being unprotected
senses.definition: the state of being left open to danger, weather, or influence
senses.definitionCN: 处于危险、天气或影响之下的状态
senses.example: Exposure to cold can make you ill.
senses.exampleCN: 受寒可能让你生病。
senses.why: The core sense is openness to harm.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是向伤害敞开。

senses.title: Public attention
senses.definition: attention given by newspapers, television, or the internet
senses.definitionCN: 报纸、电视或网络给予的关注
senses.example: The film gained wide media exposure.
senses.exampleCN: 这部电影获得了广泛的媒体曝光。
senses.why: Being seen by many becomes public attention.
senses.whyCN: 被许多人看见转为公众关注。

senses.title: Revealing a secret
senses.definition: the act of making a secret or wrong doing public
senses.definitionCN: 把秘密或错误行为公开的行为
senses.example: The exposure of the fraud shocked investors.
senses.exampleCN: 骗局被揭露令投资者震惊。
senses.why: Uncovering becomes an act of disclosure.
senses.whyCN: 揭开变成公开披露的行为。

senses.title: Photographic exposure
senses.definition: the amount of light allowed to reach film or a sensor
senses.definitionCN: 允许到达胶片或传感器的光量
senses.example: The photo failed because of over exposure.
senses.exampleCN: 这张照片因曝光过度而失败。
senses.why: Openness to light becomes a technical term.
senses.whyCN: 向光敞开变成摄影术语。

intro.en: Exposure comes from expose plus the noun ending -ure, from Latin exponere.
intro.cn: exposure 由 expose 加名词词尾 -ure 构成，根源是拉丁语 exponere。

items.en: Exponere means to put out or set forth.
items.cn: exponere 意为放出或陈述。

items.en: The ending -ura forms nouns of action or state.
items.cn: 词尾 -ura 构成表示动作或状态的名词。

items.en: Exposure develops the sense of being laid open.
items.cn: exposure 发展出「被敞开」的含义。

items.en: Exposure names the state of being unprotected.
items.cn: exposure 指未受保护的状态。

items.en: Exposure covers media attention and photography.
items.cn: 现代英语中 exposure 涵盖媒体关注与摄影。

note.en: Exposure is being seen or uncovered; enclosure is being shut in.
note.cn: exposure 是被看见或揭开，enclosure 则是被围起来。

entries.definition: an area shut off by a fence
the act of leaving
a feeling of enjoyment
a surprising fact made known
the act of making something public
the state of touching or meeting

normalIntro.en: Exposure is the noun form of expose, naming the state or act of being uncovered.
normalIntro.cn: exposure 是 expose 的名词形式，表示被揭开的状态或行为。

normal.en: Long exposure to sun can damage the skin.
normal.cn: 长时间日晒会损伤皮肤。

normal.en: The singer enjoys great exposure online.
normal.cn: 这位歌手在网上享有很高的曝光度。

normal.en: The exposure of the secret changed everything.
normal.cn: 秘密被揭露后，一切都变了。

normal.en: The camera needs a longer exposure at night.
normal.cn: 夜里拍摄需要更长的曝光时间。

normal.en: Workers demanded protection from chemical exposure.
normal.cn: 工人们要求防止化学品暴露。

abstract.en: Picture a spotlight sweeping over a hidden stage.
abstract.cn: 想象聚光灯扫过一个隐藏的舞台。

abstract.en: Imagine a sealed letter suddenly opened in public.
abstract.cn: 想象一封密封的信在众人面前突然被打开。

abstract.en: Think of a lens letting light fall on film.
abstract.cn: 想象镜头让光落在胶片上。

examples.en: The study measured exposure to pollution.
examples.cn: 这项研究测量了污染暴露程度。

examples.en: The scandal brought the company unwanted exposure.
examples.cn: 这起丑闻让公司得到了不想要的曝光。

examples.en: The exposure of the evidence led to a trial.
examples.cn: 证据被揭露后引发了审判。

dict_mnemonic.text: expose 加名词后缀 -ure，表示「被暴露的状态」，就是 exposure。

root: 由 expose 加 -ure 构成，根源是拉丁语 exponere（放出去），核心义「被敞开、显露的状态」。

sensesIntro.en: Exposure means being unprotected, public attention, the act of revealing, or photographic light.
sensesIntro.cn: exposure 意为处于无保护状态、公众关注、揭露行为，或摄影曝光。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an uncovered object seen by many eyes.
core.cn: 核心意象：被众人看见的暴露之物。

branches.en: The base sense is the state of being unprotected.
branches.cn: 基础义是未受保护的状态。

branches.en: Being seen becomes media attention.
branches.cn: 被看见变成媒体关注。

branches.en: Uncovering becomes public disclosure.
branches.cn: 揭开变成公开披露。

branches.en: Openness to light becomes a camera term.
branches.cn: 向光敞开变成摄影术语。

branches.en: Public attention and disclosure often come together.
branches.cn: 公众关注与揭露常常相伴。

intro.en: Exposure is expose plus -ure, a Latin noun ending seen in enclosure and departure.
intro.cn: exposure 由 expose 加 -ure 构成，-ure 是见于 enclosure、departure 的拉丁名词词尾。

latinIntro.en: Latin exponere and the noun ending -ura lie behind exposure.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 exponere 与名词词尾 -ura 是 exposure 的来源。

items.example: Exposure to light spoiled the film.

items.meaning: several acts or cases of exposure
items.exampleCN: 研究记录了每日的暴露次数。

items.example: Do not expose the sample to air.
Exposing a lie is not always easy.
items.exampleCN: 揭穿谎言并不总是容易。

items.example: The essay opens with an exposition.
items.exampleCN: 这篇文章以一段阐述开篇。

items.example: The chemical is exposable to heat.
items.exampleCN: 这种化学品可以暴露在高温下。

latinEntries.meaning: to put out or set forth

definition_zh: 时间表；时刻表；课程表；日程表；制定时间表
definition_en: a list or chart showing the times at which classes, trains, or events take place, or the plan itself
core_image: 一张方格纸，每一格都填着一个钟点与一件事
scene: 新学期的教室后墙贴出了一张表，密密麻麻写满课程。 Someone had already written the timetable on the blackboard for the first week.
sceneCN: 这里 timetable 是「课程表」（第 3 个义项：学校的上课时间表）；句意为有人已经把第一周的时间表写在黑板上。画面里有方格表格、钟点与粉笔字。

pos.zh: 名词：时间表；时刻表；课程表
动词：为……安排时间；列入时间表

derivatives.zh: 由词根 time 加过去分词结尾，义为「定时的；计时的」
由词根 time 加 -er 构成，义为「计时器」
由词根 time 加 -ing 构成，义为「时机；计时」

senses.title: A list of times
senses.definition: a list showing the times at which things are planned to happen
senses.definitionCN: 列出各项事情计划发生时间的清单
senses.example: The new timetable cuts ten minutes off the morning train.
senses.exampleCN: 新时刻表让早班列车少花十分钟。
senses.why: A table in English is both a chart and a flat surface, so a table of times is a timetable.
senses.whyCN: 英语的 table 既指表格又指平面，所以「时间的表」就是 timetable。

senses.title: A schedule for transport
senses.definition: a printed or posted list of train, bus, or plane times
senses.definitionCN: 张贴或印刷的班次时间表
senses.example: Check the bus timetable before you leave.
senses.exampleCN: 出发前查一下公交时刻表。
senses.why: Transport is the place where exact times matter most, so this is the sense most people meet first.
senses.whyCN: 交通是最讲究精确时间的场合，因此这是多数人最先遇到的用法。

senses.title: A school class schedule
senses.definition: a weekly chart of lessons showing subject, teacher, and room
senses.definitionCN: 标明科目、教师与教室的一周课表
senses.example: Our timetable is full every afternoon.
senses.exampleCN: 我们每天下午的课表都排满了。
senses.why: School life is divided into fixed slots just like a printed table.
senses.whyCN: 学校生活被划成固定格子，正如印出来的表格。

senses.title: A plan of events
senses.definition: a plan listing the order and dates of a series of events or steps
senses.definitionCN: 列出系列活动或步骤顺序与日期的计划
senses.example: The committee agreed on a timetable for the reforms.
senses.exampleCN: 委员会就改革的日程表达成了一致。
senses.why: Beyond clocks and classes, any long plan can be laid out as a table of dates.
senses.whyCN: 除钟点和课程之外，任何长期计划都可摊成一张日期表。

senses.title: To schedule something
senses.definition: to arrange for an event or service to take place at a stated time
senses.definitionCN: 安排某活动或服务在特定时间进行
senses.example: The hearing is timetabled for next Tuesday.
senses.exampleCN: 听证会安排在周二。
senses.why: The noun becomes a verb: to put an item into one of the table's slots.
senses.whyCN: 名词变动词：把一件事放进表格的某一格。

senses.title: A political programme of dates
senses.definition: a published plan of dates for proposed legislation or negotiations
senses.definitionCN: 公布的法案或谈判的时间规划
senses.example: The government published a timetable for the withdrawal.
senses.exampleCN: 政府公布了撤军时间规划。
senses.why: Public promises need dates, so the word entered politics as a schedule of commitments.
senses.whyCN: 公开承诺需要日期，本词因此以「承诺日程」的身份进入政治。

senses.title: A posted chart in a station
senses.definition: the large board on a platform that shows departure times
senses.definitionCN: 站台上显示发车时间的大牌
senses.example: A crowd stared at the timetable after the delay was announced.
senses.exampleCN: 延误公布后，一群人盯着时刻牌看。
senses.why: The document becomes a fixed public object on a wall, readable by anyone waiting.
senses.whyCN: 文件成了墙上固定的公共物件，任何等待的人都能读。

senses.title: A method of learning in small steps
senses.definition: a scheme that sets out the order in which material is learned
senses.definitionCN: 规定学习材料先后顺序的方案
senses.example: Some language courses sell a ready-made timetable of lessons.
senses.exampleCN: 有些语言课程出售现成的分步教学计划。
senses.why: Teaching is a sequence of steps, and a sequence laid out in order is again a table.
senses.whyCN: 教学是一串步骤，按序排开的步骤又是一张表。

intro.en: The word is a straightforward English compound of time and table, put together in the modern period when printed schedules became common.
intro.cn: 这是一个由 time 与 table 直接组成的英语复合词，在印刷时刻表普及的近代成形。

items.en: Tima supplied the first element, meaning an allotted period.
items.cn: 第一成分 tima 意为被分配的时段。

items.en: Tabula, a board or writing tablet, is the distant source of table.
items.cn: 拉丁语 tabula（板、书写用的平板）是 table 的远源。

items.en: Tabule entered English in the sense of a flat writing surface.
items.cn: tabule 以「平面书写板」的意义进入英语。

items.en: Table extends from a flat board to any arranged set of figures or times.
items.cn: table 从平板扩展到任何排好的数字或时间列。

items.en: Timetable appears as printed railway schedules spread in the nineteenth century.
items.cn: 随着十九世纪铁路时刻表普及，timetable 出现。

items.en: The word spreads from transport to schools, projects, and political plans.
items.cn: 本词从交通扩展到学校、项目与政治的规划。

note.en: The look-alike group collects time compounds, and the near-meaning group gathers the words for schedules and plans.
note.cn: 形近组收集以 time 开头的复合词，近义组聚集表示时刻表与计划的词。

normalIntro.en: These memories work from the two halves of the compound and from the places the word appears.
normalIntro.cn: 下面几条从复合词的两半以及本词出现的地方入手。

normal.en: Timetable is simply time plus table, a table filled with times.
normal.cn: timetable 就是 time 加 table，填着时间的表。

normal.en: The railway gave the word its first home, so the train timetable came before the school one.
normal.cn: 铁路是本词最早的家，火车时刻表先于学校课表。

normal.en: The verb keeps the same spelling, so timetabled means put into a slot.
normal.cn: 动词拼写不变，timetabled 意为「已排定」。

normal.en: Draw up a timetable is the common verb phrase for making one.
normal.cn: draw up a timetable 是制造时间表的常用搭配。

normal.en: Agenda, roster, and schedule are its close cousins in the planning family.
normal.cn: agenda、roster、schedule 是计划类词里的近亲。

abstract.en: Picture a grid where every square holds a number and a name.
abstract.cn: 想象一张方格纸，每格都填着一个号码与一个名字。

abstract.en: Think of a platform board clicking over to a new time.
abstract.cn: 想站台上的翻牌牌面咔哒一声跳到新时间。

abstract.en: A timetable is a promise made of hours.
abstract.cn: 时间表就是用小时写成的承诺。

examples.en: The new timetable starts on Monday.
examples.cn: 新时间表从周一开始。

examples.en: She checked the train timetable before booking a ticket.
examples.cn: 订票前她查了列车时刻表。

examples.en: The manager timetabled the training for Thursday afternoon.
examples.cn: 经理把培训安排在周四下午。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「太木台布」——一块太木的台布，上面印着所有钟点。

root: 由 time（古英语 tima，时段）与 table（拉丁 tabula，板、书写平板）复合而成，十九世纪铁路印刷时刻表普及后定名。

sensesIntro.en: A table of hours covers trains, lessons, projects, and political promises, and the verb then puts anything into one of its slots.
sensesIntro.cn: 一张小时表既覆盖列车，也覆盖课程、项目与政治承诺；动词则把任何事放进表格的某一格。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a grid in which each cell holds a clock time and a task.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张方格表，每格一个钟点与一件事。

branches.en: The printed list and its posted form.
branches.cn: 印刷清单及其张贴形态。

branches.en: Transport as the word's first home.
branches.cn: 交通是本词最初的家。

branches.en: Schools and step-by-step teaching.
branches.cn: 学校与分步教学。

branches.en: Long plans and political dates.
branches.cn: 长期计划与政治日程。

branches.en: The verb of placing something in a slot.
branches.cn: 把某事放进格子的动词用法。

intro.en: This compound is built from two free English words, so the affix work looks at its halves and the endings that make it a verb.
intro.cn: 这个复合词由两个独立英语词构成，因此构词要点在于它的两半以及把它变成动词的词尾。

latinIntro.en: Only the second half reaches back to Latin tabula; the Latin list gives that word and near neighbours.
latinIntro.cn: 只有后半可追溯到拉丁语 tabula；拉丁表给出该词及邻近的对照词。

items.exampleCN: 前半标明表格所记述的东西。

items.example: The second half names the form.

items.exampleCN: timetables 既是复数也是动词形式。

Timetabling is the work of scheduling.
